SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.DEPTNO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPARTMENT, ESS.APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(ESS.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') APPLY_LEAVE_DATE, TO_CHAR( ESS.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') LEAVE_FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR( ESS.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') LEAVE_TO_TIME, ESS.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, ESS.SUB_LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ESS.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) LEAVE_TYPE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ESS.SUB_LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SUB_LEAVE_TYPE_NAME, SUBSTR(ESS.REMARK, 0, 8) REMARK, ESS.REMARK REMARK_DETAIL, ESS.CURRENT_AFFIRM_ID, ESS.ACTIVITY, ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG, ESS.FILE_URL, ESS.FILE_NAME, ESS.APPLY_LENGTH/8 || 'Days' APPLY_LENGTH, ESS.LEAVE_REASON, ESS.BATCH_APPLY_NO, ESS.UNDO_APPLY_NO, F_GET_APPLY_DEPTNAME(ESS.APPLY_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#, ESS.APPLY_TYPE,ESS.UNDO_APPLY_NO) BATCH_APPLY_DEPT_NAME, nvl((SELECT 1 FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB where UNDO_APPLY_NO = ESS.APPLY_NO AND AFFIRM_FLAG <> 2 ),0) CAL_FLAG FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ESS WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = ESS.PERSON_ID
HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE = #EmpTypeCodeNo:VARCHAR#
HE.emp_office = #EmpOffice:VARCHAR#
HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT JOBTYPE_NO FROM HR_JOB_TYPE_SETUP P WHERE JOBTYPE_GROUP_NO = #JobTypeGroupNo# AND CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# )
TO_CHAR(ESS.APPLY_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') = #APPLY_TIME:VARCHAR#
ESS.BATCH_APPLY_NO like '%' || trim(#BATCH_APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#) || '%'
ESS.APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#
HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ESS.APPLY_NO = #APPLY_NO:VARCHAR#
ESS.LEAVE_TO_TIME >= TO_DATE(#FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ESS.LEAVE_FROM_TIME <= TO_DATE(#TO_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE HR.PERSON_ID = ESS.PERSON_ID AND (HR.EMPID LIKE upper('%$KEY$%') OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE upper('%$KEY$%') OR HR.CHINESE_PINYIN LIKE upper('%$KEY$%')) )
ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG = -1
ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG = 0
ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG = 1
ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG = 2
ESS.AFFIRM_FLAG = 3
ESS.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HE.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND ROWNUM = 1) OR HE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# ) AND ( EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_EMPTYPE_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_EMPTYPE_INFO.EMP_TYPE_CODE = HE.EMP_TYPE_CODE AND AR_SUPERVISOR_EMPTYPE_INFO.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND ROWNUM = 1 ) OR HE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# )
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO=HE.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
ORDER BY ESS.CREATE_DATE DESC
